title: Run Your Rules
briefing: Meadow Pharma offers the same setup three times: a pullback in an uptrend. Use the same rule each time, with the same stop, and judge the results together.
objective: Test an edge by repeating one rule with fixed risk, and judge the set of trades, not one result.
debrief: Meadow Pharma pulled back three times: on day 6, day 16 and day 26. The first two pullbacks recovered and paid well. The third, after the trial delay, kept falling and hit the stop for a small loss. Taken together, the same rule with the same stop still came out ahead: two wins larger than one controlled loss. A disciplined player applied the rule every time and kept each loss small.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma slips as a rival launches a similar drug
news.body: Analysts expect the rival to win only a small share of the market.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma dips after a large shareholder sells
news.body: A pension fund trimmed its stake to rebalance its portfolio.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma delays a late-stage trial by six months
news.body: The company needs more patients before it can report results.

basic.text: Keep your worst drop within your plan's maximum loss
Use a stop-loss on your entries

bonus.text: Test the setup at least twice (4 or more trades)
